name: g4boston
caption:
43 TO SAVE THE FINALS 🎮🏀 Down two games to one in the 2022 Finals. Steph had to answer.

• Game 4, June 10, 2022: 43 points, 10 rebounds
• 14 of 26 from the field, 7 of 14 from three
• We win 107-97, series tied 2-2
• First player in Finals history with 5+ threes in 4 straight games

Steph's best game ever? 👇

facts.claim: June 10 (2022), Game 4 of the NBA Finals at Boston: Curry 43 points and 10 rebounds in a 107-97 win to even the series at 2-2 (we were down 1-2, 2-1 Boston); first player in Finals history to make 5+ three-pointers in four (4) consecutive games
